mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 1.5% for two consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to expected corporate earnings, lowering the present value of future cash flows and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% and remains above for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during the preceding 30-day average when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by at least 2% month-over-month while UNRATE decreases by at least 0.2 percentage points in the same or
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) when both PAYEMS growth and UNRATE declines are statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% suggests accelerating demand for goods and services, which elevates earnings expectations and supports higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly growth rate exceeds 0.3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day log returns of SPX are not higher than the 5-day average during the identified demand acceleration period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) accompanied by a decline in inventory levels (not directly observable in the provided proxies, but assumed to be reflected in market expectations) indicates tight supply conditions that raise inflation expectations and depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by at least 5% month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during the prior 30-day average when INDPRO declines as specified.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate remains persistently below 1%, it signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers real interest rates, encouraging capital accumulation in equities and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS stays below 1% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the 30-day historical average during the low-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in job openings (not directly observable, but proxy via labor market tightness inferred from PAYEMS and UNRATE interaction) combined with rising wage growth (implied but not directly observable) creates uncertainty that drives equity selling and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls by >5% while UNRATE remains below 4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative when the specified labor market indicators form a significant negative interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 2% triggers a preemptive rate hike expectation that compresses equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% and rises for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than during the prior 30-day average when CPIAUCSL inflation crosses above 2%.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inventory levels (not directly observable but inferred from market sentiment), investors anticipate future supply disruptions, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for four consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative when INDPRO shows the specified downward trend.
